parts.name: CollapsibleRoot
parts.description: The `<details>` element. It holds the open state and shares it with the parts inside it. Style it with `[open]`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the panel is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the collapsible.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the panel is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the trigger asks to open or close the panel, and after the browser opened it by itself for find-in-page. A controlled collapsible follows `open`, and is closed again if `open` stays false. It is called in a change of its own, after the component's: a handler that starts a request, writes what a loading question reads, or is an action that awaits, never holds the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the trigger is disabled: it ignores presses and keys and leaves the tab order. Find-in-page still opens the panel.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is disabled.

parts.name: CollapsibleTrigger
parts.description: The `<summary>` that opens and closes the panel. It must be the first child of the root. A press asks the root rather than toggling the element, so a controlled `open` decides.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is disabled.

parts.name: CollapsiblePanel
parts.description: The content after the summary, hidden by the browser while the collapsible is closed. Its measured size is written to CSS variables for animating its height.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel animates out. The `<details>` stays open until the panel's transitions and animations finish.

cssVariables.name: --collapsible-panel-height
cssVariables.description: The panel's content height: in px while it opens and closes, `auto` once it is open.

cssVariables.name: --collapsible-panel-width
cssVariables.description: The panel's content width: in px while it opens and closes, `auto` once it is open.
